per_finding.note: The triage does not mention air in the cooling system or lack of water as the root cause.
R-005 notes standby switchover did not take effect but does not identify the shared water circulation as the reason.
The triage does not address the chillers being bound into a cluster preventing individual restart.
R-006 directs progressive thermal load reduction, including terminating non-critical workloads, matching the load reduction action.
The triage does not mention manufacturer involvement or manual unbinding/restart of chillers.
The triage does not mention the fire sprinkler system or water damage to equipment.
The triage does not address ensuring automatic and manual failover effectiveness as a remediation.
The triage includes planning to power down servers but does not call for a standardized contingency plan with clarified shutdown criteria.
The triage does not mention expanding monitoring scope or metrics.
